opendnssec_dns_tsig_name.description: The TSIG key name used for DNS authentication.

opendnssec_dns_inbound_xfr_key.description: The TSIG key name to use for zone transfer requests to the IPv6 host.

opendnssec_dns_inbound_notify_address.description: IP prefix to allow NOTIFY messages from.

opendnssec_dns_outbound_xfr_address.description: IP prefix to provide zone transfers to.

opendnssec_dns_outbound_notify_address.description: IP address to send NOTIFY messages to.
